title: Stripe and Link Launch Agent Wallet for Instinct AI
summary:
Users of the Instinct AI agent in the U.S. can now fund a digital wallet to allow their AI to execute autonomous purchases on their behalf. The feature, called Link balance, was developed in partnership with Stripe and Link and lets users set a total budget and individual purchase limits so the agent can shop without requiring a credit card or manual approval for every transaction.

The payment tool is available in eligible U.S. regions starting Oct. 26, with a rollout to New York scheduled for a later date. The system is designed to handle automated tasks such as ordering recurring grocery items or purchasing concert tickets immediately upon the opening of a presale.

selectedTweets.text:
Give your Instinct a budget

Built with @Stripe and @link, we're launching Link balance in @instinct. You can now set a budget for your Instinct to make purchases on your behalf, and Instinct does the rest.

You choose how much money to add and set a limit for each purchase. Your Instinct can spend within those limits, without needing access to your credit card or asking for approval every time.

That means buying tickets as soon as the presale opens, picking up your size when the trail runners restock, or reordering your favorite coffee beans every other week.

Link balance is rolling out to Instinct users across the US starting today, with New York coming soon.

Ask your Instinct to set up Link balance and it’ll send you a link to get started.
